newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela official says no electricity hike yet.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela official says no electricity hike yet.

text.p: Venezuela's Vice Minister of Energy and Mines Evanan Romero denied Wednesday press reports of an imminent 20 percent rise in electricity tariffs, adding the government was still studying proposals.
"There is still no decision. We're in the process of revision and discussion and have not yet reached agreement," Romero told reporters.
Recent press reports have stoked rumors of a 20 percent rise in tariffs this week, with further hikes spread over the rest of the year.

State-owned electricity companies have recently added their voices to private sector calls, principally by leading utility Electricidad de Caracas, for increases in tariffs which have not kept up with inflation that topped 100 percent last year.
